title: Swap header logo placeholder with provided logo image

requirements.summary: Replace the header scissors placeholder with the provided logo image, ensuring responsive sizing, meaningful alt text, and a non-breaking fallback on load failure.
acceptanceCriteria: The header no longer shows the scissors placeholder icon; it shows the logo from 1770202565370.png instead.
The logo is sized appropriately for the existing header height (does not overflow or cause layout shifts) on mobile and desktop.
The logo includes meaningful alt text in English (e.g., "Baba Farid Tailor logo").
If the logo image fails to load for any reason, a reasonable fallback is shown (e.g., the existing placeholder component or a text-only fallback) without breaking layout.

file_operations.description: Add the user-provided logo image as a static frontend asset (copy from provided asset 1770202565370.png). Ensure the app references this static path and does not route images through the backend.

Create a dedicated header-branding logo component that renders an using the static asset at frontend/public/assets/1770202565370.png with responsive sizing (fit within the header height) and meaningful alt text (e.g., "Baba Farid Tailor logo"). Implement a safe onError fallback that swaps to the existing LogoPlaceholder (or a compact text-only fallback) without breaking layout.

Replace the current LogoPlaceholder usage in the header branding area with the new BrandLogo component, preserving the existing layout, spacing, and premium theme styling. Ensure the logo container remains stable to avoid layout shifts on load.
